requirement: Online stock and billing for a retail chain in India, 40 stores, 300 internal staff, 8,000 transactions/day, must not go down in business hours.
class: internal line-of-business web app, HA required, low request rate

aws.note: Three-tier: ALB -> EC2/ASG in private subnets -> RDS Multi-AZ. CDN and WAF are not part of the base pattern.

gcp.note: Fetched: Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud Storage, Cloud Load Balancing, VPC. Memorystore is listed, so cache is allowed but not required at this rate.

azure.note: CORRECTED. This expected a WAF, taken from the baseline zone-redundant reference -- which is a PUBLIC app secured behind Application Gateway. F1 is 300 internal staff. Scoring an internal workload against a public-app reference was the audit assuming an attack surface, which is the exact defect it caught in the product.
